items.name: Happy
items.note: A small lift; the smile opens with each breath.

items.name: Joyful
items.note: Two buoyant lifts and a widening smile.

items.name: Laughing
items.note: The eyes squeeze while the jaw follows two chuckles.

items.name: Excited
items.note: A quick double lift and bright, raised brows.

items.name: Loved
items.note: Each heart eye beats softly on its own.

items.name: Proud
items.note: The chin lifts; the gaze follows and holds.

items.name: Grateful
items.note: A slow nod with closed, softened eyes.

items.name: Hopeful
items.note: The eyes lift before settling back into a small smile.

items.name: Fine
items.note: An easy sway and an unhurried blink.

items.name: Neutral
items.note: Quiet breathing with a deliberate double blink.

items.name: Calm
items.note: Even breathing barely moves the closed-eyed smile.

items.name: Content
items.note: A gentle nod with a restrained smile.

items.name: Relieved
items.note: A held breath releases into a thinning puff.

items.name: Focused
items.note: The narrowed eyes hold still, then make a tiny adjustment.

items.name: Curious
items.note: A raised brow and a close, upward glance.

items.name: Sleepy
items.note: The face nods down as a small yawn opens and closes.

items.name: Sad
items.note: The gaze lowers before the mouth settles into a frown.

items.name: Lonely
items.note: A sideways glance lingers, then slowly returns.

items.name: Disappointed
items.note: The eyes sink; a small lip tremor fades into stillness.

items.name: Hurt
items.note: A short recoil, a trembling lip and a long settle.

items.name: Exhausted
items.note: A heavy droop with slow, shallow breathing.

items.name: Bored
items.note: The flat gaze travels slowly from side to side.

items.name: Crying
items.note: One tear forms at the eye, stretches and slides down the cheek.

items.name: Unwell
items.note: A short shiver interrupts the uneasy mouth.

items.name: Worried
items.note: The worried brows lift as the gaze makes small uncertain shifts.

items.name: Anxious
items.note: The eyes dart; a bead of sweat grows and runs down.

items.name: Stressed
items.note: A squeeze of the eyes and jaw builds into a short tremble.

items.name: Angry
items.note: The brows tighten; the jaw tenses before a restrained shake.

items.name: Frustrated
items.note: A deliberate head shake ends in a clipped breath.

items.name: Confused
items.note: The eyes search between two questioning tilts.

items.name: Surprised
items.note: The eyes widen first; the mouth follows with a short gasp.

items.name: Embarrassed
items.note: The gaze drops as the cheeks slowly warm.

items.name: Beaming
items.note: A held, toothy smile broadens between blinks.

items.name: Ecstatic
items.note: Tightly smiling eyes, two hops and a brief sparkle.

items.name: Amused
items.note: A restrained chuckle lifts one side of the smile.

items.name: Tears of Joy
items.note: Tears flick outward from the smiling eyes as the jaw chuckles.

items.name: Rolling Laughter
items.note: The little face rocks through laughter while tears flick out.

items.name: Cheeky
items.note: A sideways look leads into a crooked smile.

items.name: Winking
items.note: One eye closes, holds the wink, then opens again.

items.name: Tongue Out
items.note: The tongue extends slightly, then relaxes into the smile.

items.name: Playful Wink
items.note: A timed wink lands with a little tongue movement.

items.name: Silly
items.note: Squinted eyes and a small tongue wobble follow a chuckle.

items.name: Zany
items.note: Uneven eyes and a loose tongue make a slightly offbeat laugh.

items.name: Savoring
items.note: A little tongue sweeps toward one corner of the smile.

items.name: Blowing a Kiss
items.note: A wink, a puckered mouth, then a heart drifting outward.

items.name: Kissing
items.note: The closed-eyed face leans into a small pucker.

items.name: Bashful
items.note: A small downturned tilt brings a soft blush to both cheeks.

items.name: Affectionate
items.note: Small hearts rise at alternating sides of the face.

items.name: Starstruck
items.note: Each star eye turns and brightens with the intake of breath.

items.name: Angelic
items.note: A thin halo floats gently above a contented smile.

items.name: Cool
items.note: A slow chin lift and a quiet, confident smile.

items.name: Smug
items.note: The narrowed eyes glance aside as the chin lifts.

items.name: Celebrating
items.note: A striped party hat, extending curled blower, and falling confetti.

items.name: Hugging
items.note: Two little open hands curl toward the cheeks and ease apart.

items.name: Bittersweet
items.note: A smile holds while a single tear slides from one eye.

items.name: Holding Back Tears
items.note: The eyes glisten; a trembling smile tries to stay in place.

items.name: Pleading
items.note: The small bright eyes lift with raised inner brows.

items.name: Loudly Crying
items.note: Continuous deep-blue streams fall from both eyes; white streaks travel downward with each sob.

items.name: Heartbroken
items.note: Bright, watery eyes lower after a recoil; a deeper trembling frown holds as one tear slips down.

items.name: Devastated
items.note: Closed, downcast eyes, a heavy droop and a trembling frown sit behind two slow, uninterrupted tear streams.

items.name: Pensive
items.note: The face lowers into a long, thoughtful pause.

items.name: Regretful
items.note: A small head shake gives way to a downcast frown.

items.name: Disheartened
items.note: The face sinks and holds through a slow breath.

items.name: Uneasy
items.note: A hesitant look passes from one side to the other.

items.name: Nervous
items.note: A tense grin holds while the eyes dart and sweat beads.

items.name: Panicked
items.note: Quick eye movements, a shallow gasp and a trembling face.

items.name: Terrified
items.note: The eyes freeze open as small hands press against the cheeks.

items.name: Shocked
items.note: Pinpoint pupils freeze in wide eyes after a sharp recoil; the squared jaw stays dropped.

items.name: Awestruck
items.note: The gaze lifts and holds a long, wondering breath.

items.name: Stunned
items.note: The crossed eyes remain fixed while the face sways slowly.

items.name: Speechless
items.note: A double blink and a held stare carry the expression without a mouth.

items.name: Suspicious
items.note: A narrowed sideways gaze pauses beneath one raised brow.

items.name: Skeptical
items.note: One brow lifts before a restrained questioning tilt.

items.name: Thinking
items.note: The eyes look up as the hand supports the jaw from below.

items.name: Eye Rolling
items.note: The pupils roll up, trace across the top, then return to their resting position.

items.name: Unimpressed
items.note: A slow, flat look moves aside and waits.

items.name: Expressionless
items.note: A nearly still face, carried by a small breath.

items.name: Frantic
items.note: A restless gaze, a shaky mouth and short bursts of movement.

items.name: Furious
items.note: The brows push down; a small tension mark pulses at the temple.

items.name: Swearing
items.note: The jaw and symbol bar shake in a brief angry burst.

items.name: Fuming
items.note: Two puffs grow from the nostrils and drift outward as they thin.

items.name: Determined
items.note: The chin steadies under firm brows and a set jaw.

items.name: Grimacing
items.note: A clenched row of teeth tightens through a short shiver.

items.name: Dizzy
items.note: The two spiral eyes rotate in opposite directions as the face sways.

items.name: Dazed
items.note: The little pupils circle inside still eyes, slightly out of phase.

items.name: Woozy
items.note: Uneven eyes drift while a loose mouth wobbles below them.

items.name: Overwhelmed
items.note: Spiral eyes keep turning while the face makes a small overwhelmed tremble.

items.name: Sleeping
items.note: Even breathing sends three small sleep marks upward in sequence.

items.name: Yawning
items.note: The jaw opens into a long yawn as one hand rises to cover it.

items.name: Drooling
items.note: A narrow strand grows from one mouth corner and drips toward the chin.

items.name: Nauseated
items.note: The cheeks tense as the mouth shifts through two small waves of nausea.

items.name: Vomiting
items.note: A continuous green stream runs from the open mouth to the chin, with lighter ribbons and flecks flowing down inside it.

items.name: Feverish
items.note: A thermometer rests at the mouth while a bead of sweat slowly descends.

items.name: Cold Face
items.note: Frost spreads over the forehead and chin; snow crystals flicker, icicles shake, and the teeth chatter above a small icy breath.

items.name: Overheated
items.note: A short pant moves the tongue while sweat and heat lines rise and fall.

items.name: Sneezing
items.note: A quick recoil brings the tissue to the mouth; a tiny puff escapes and fades.

items.name: Astonished
items.note: Large white eyes, high arched brows and a long, tooth-topped open mouth hold a slower jaw-drop than Surprised.

items.name: Face in Clouds
items.note: Three drifting cloud layers surround the face; broad billows frame the eyes and pass across the lower cheeks.

items.name: Clown
items.note: Red puffed hair, blue eye paint, round cheeks, a red nose and a broad painted grin move through a comic double bounce.

items.name: Exploding Head
items.note: A short freeze bursts into a rising cloud of steam, with a broken forehead rim and tiny orange sparks.

items.name: Head Bandage
items.note: A wrapped diagonal bandage and a small pad move with a careful, pained recoil.

items.name: Medical Mask
items.note: A pleated mask covers the mouth, gently expanding with the breath beneath tired eyes.

items.name: Monocle
items.note: One lifted brow peers through a round lens; its fine chain follows the questioning tilt.

items.name: Nerd
items.note: Round glasses and two little front teeth frame an eager upward glance.

items.name: Cowboy
items.note: A broad hat, creased crown and dark band tilt through a friendly nod.

items.name: Disguised
items.note: Heavy eyebrows, round glasses, a protruding nose and moustache accompany a careful side glance.

items.name: Saluting
items.note: A slim horizontal hand meets the top of the forehead.

items.name: Peeking
items.note: Two rounded palms hide the face. One finger eases aside so a single eye can peek through, then closes the gap again.

items.name: Shushing
items.note: A curved index finger rests at the lips, with the folded hand below.

items.name: Zipper Mouth
items.note: A tiny zipper pull travels across the mouth before returning to rest at one corner.

items.name: Mischievous
items.note: Two small horns, a crooked smile and a sidelong glance carry a playful challenge.

items.name: Angry with Horns
items.note: The same horned head tightens into a hard frown and a short, tense shake.
